item.title: March Madness mismatch: No. 2 Michigan routs Holy Cross 83-48 in women's NCAA Tournament
item.description: Mila Holloway and Syla Swords each had seven points in a dominant opening quarter and combined to score 33 points, leading second-seeded Michigan to an 83-48 win over 15th-seeded Holy Cross in the first round of the women’s NCAA Tournament.

item.title: Jaylen Brown has 30 points as Celtics rally to defeat Grizzlies 117-112
item.description: Jaylen Brown scored 30 points, Luka Garza added a season-high 22 points and the Boston Celtics used a fourth-quarter rally to defeat the Memphis Grizzlies 117-112. Payton Pritchard added 19 points for the Celtics, who have won four straight.

item.title: Repost: Sex &amp; Aging
item.description: A podcast that fields all your questions and offers radical empathy in return.

item.title: The Latest: Israel intensifying attacks, Iran shows defiance, nuclear site hit
item.description: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz said attacks against Iran will “increase significantly” in the coming week. Katz spoke Saturday, hours after U.S. President Donald Trump said he was considering “winding down” military operations in the Mideast.

item.title: Former FBI Director Robert Mueller, who investigated Russia-Trump campaign ties, dies
item.description: Robert S. Mueller III, the FBI director who transformed the nation’s premier law enforcement agency into a terrorism-fighting force after the Sept. 11, 2001, attacks and who later became special counsel in charge of investigating ties between Russia and Donald Trump’s presidential campaign, has died. He was 81.

item.title: Former Boston organizer Monica Cannon-Grant ordered to pay $224,000 in federal fraud case
item.description: In 2022, Monica Cannon-Grant and her late husband, Clark Grant, were charged in a sweeping federal indictment that alleged they used the Violence in Boston donations for vacations and personal expenses.

item.title: Why Mass. plays 'a huge role' in national abortion access since the fall of Roe v. Wade
item.description: The latest abortion numbers in Massachusetts signal dramatic changes in national abortion dynamics — and the Bay State’s role in that picture — since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade in 2022.

item.title: Three Greater Boston artists receive $75,000 awards
item.description: Tomashi Jackson, Yu-Wen Wu and Lucy Kim make up the new cohort of Wagner arts fellows. The fellowship is designed to build the artists’ practices and continue making socially engaged work.

item.title: Supreme Court weighs tightening asylum rules
item.description: The Supreme Court is considering the legality of a policy that bars migrants at the border from entering the U.S. and applying for asylum.

item.title: Traders place bets on oil amid Iran war. Are they engaging in insider trading?
item.description: On Monday, several traders bet hundreds of millions of dollars on oil contracts shortly before President Trump announced the postponement of U.S. strikes on Iranian energy infrastructure.

item.title: How did an assignment to write about sports betting turn into a gambling compulsion? Pretty easily
item.description: Sports betting has a powerful grip on the nation.

item.title: People are buying unregulated, injectable peptides from Chinese factories. Are they safe?
item.description: Social media influencers tout the benefits — from weight loss to collagen production to pain reduction — and direct followers to websites to buy peptides.

item.title: Copper and Dumplings | Ep. 319
item.description: Recorded live in Cleveland, OH, this Japanese story pits a wise baker against two tricky goblins who refuse to face their fears.

item.title: 'We the Women': Learn about history's hidden heroes this Women's History Month
item.description: The book details stories of American heroines who helped change the course of U.S. history.

item.title: Inside the breakdown of U.S.-Iran nuclear talks
item.description: Ali Vaez was involved with the 2015 negotiations that led to the Iran Nuclear Deal. He'll explain why, even as a new deal was tantalizingly close late last month, the U.S. and Israel launched their war against Iran.
